criteria.description: Copy preserves Errors and Accepted elements in independent slice backing storage, and preserves nil when unset.
criteria.required_interface: gin.Context.Copy with Errors and Accepted fields

criteria.description: Writer state, request data, keys, parameters, handlers and paths retain the existing copy behavior.

criteria.evaluator_guidance: Inspect /reference/index.json and the patch for 293ad7e to ground copy-isolation and retained-copy behavior in context.go and the TestContextCopy tests. Exercise content, nil preservation, and independent slice backing storage by replacing existing elements in a copied slice; pointed-to error objects need not be deep-cloned. Run the candidate's focused tests and assess its regression coverage. Accept equivalent implementations and safe improvements without exact patch or file-boundary requirements. The reference is evaluator-only; wiring failures are HARNESS_ERROR/unassessed, and source-only observations without executed coverage remain unassessed.
